items.text: Two prisoners sentenced for drug-related crimes were executed in Shahrud prison. One prisoner in Ilam was spared execution after 15 years through mediation by elders. Additionally, 22 prisoners sentenced to death in West Azerbaijan were released through reconciliation in the first half of this year.

Abbas Araghchi stated that the Islamic Republic is ready to continue diplomacy if it sees sincere evidence of the US's willingness to build trust. He warned that if the US prefers war, it will face a strategic defeat. Araghchi also highlighted the risks of escalating tensions in the region and said there is little hope for progress under current conditions.

Barcelona has filed a complaint with UEFA against Paris Saint-Germain due to a violent display by PSG fans before their Champions League match. The display showed a masked figure destroying Barcelona's emblem with a chainsaw, accompanied by the phrase "Parisian-style massacre." Barcelona considered this act offensive.

Protesters distributed protest leaflets against the Islamic Republic around the Faculty of Skills and Entrepreneurship in the city of Qods on the evening of Tuesday, October 20. This video was released by Iran International.

Amirhossein Sabeti, Tehran representative, said that to avoid a prolonged war, it is necessary to fight well for a period. He emphasized that the smallest military movement by the enemy should be met with a strong response. He also highlighted the importance of controlling energy prices and the Strait of Hormuz.

Ali Alipour, the father of Babak Alipour, a political prisoner who was executed, was arrested on Tuesday, October 20, in Rasht and transferred to the Shohada-ye Gomnam detention center. At the same time, electronic devices belonging to him and his family were confiscated by agents. This news was reported by the HRANA news agency.

Mehdi Mahdavi Azad stated that with the intensification of sanctions and Iran's isolation, the income of smuggling networks affiliated with the IRGC increases. He warned that this situation will lead to increased poverty and social divides. He also described the Islamic Republic's policies as an effort to maintain power at the cost of destroying Iran's economy and society.

Workers laid off from Khavar Rasht spinning factory reported three months of unpaid wages, six months of unpaid insurance, and unpaid severance. They oppose being referred to unemployment insurance near retirement. Additionally, about 200 workers at Dehdasht brick factory have several months of unpaid wages, and production at this factory resumed today.

A man accused of sexually assaulting two women has been arrested. He gained the trust of the women by impersonating a well-known TV host on a dating site. After luring them to an apartment, he sexually assaulted them.

Como defeated Manchester United 4-1 at the Sinigaglia stadium. Cesc Fabregas' team dominated the match, and Manchester United could not control the game. This match is considered the greatest night in Como's history.
An 11th-grade student in Bam was beaten by his teacher. The student sustained injuries to the head and face. This incident occurred today.

A citizen sent a video showing a nighttime government gathering in Mehrshahr, Karaj. He says there were zero attendees and loudspeakers were used to make it seem like there were many people. The video was recorded on Wednesday, October 21.

Reuters reported on Wednesday, 29 Mehr, citing three American officials, that the US State Department is preparing to order the departure of a number of staff and their family members from US embassies in Gulf countries. Two American officials said this action is due to the possibility of resumption of conflicts, especially with Iran-backed Houthis in Yemen.

Scott Bessent, the US Treasury Secretary, in response to new sanctions against five individuals, four companies, and nine ships for cooperation with the Islamic Republic, wrote on X that supporters of the Iranian regime will be sanctioned. He said those helping the Islamic Republic must choose whether they are with the US or against it. He added that the US knows who they are and what they do, and will continue its actions.

The Iranian Football Federation announced that Yahya Golmohammadi will be the head coach of Iran's under-23 team until the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics. After terminating his contract with Duhok Club in Iraq, he will return to Iran and sign a new contract with the Football Federation. Golmohammadi will start working with the under-23 team from the November FIFA international window.

Turkey, Qatar, Pakistan, and Indonesia signed the Badr memorandum of understanding in Doha to expand defense cooperation. The agreement covers military production, technical training, and research and development. Defense ministers and their deputies attended the signing ceremony.
Neighboring countries have closed their land borders with Iran. This issue was mentioned in the audio version of Cheshmandaz. No further details are provided in this report.

Paris police have requested the French football league to change the time of the Paris Saint-Germain and Lyon match due to security concerns from ongoing unrest. The match may be moved to Monday, but no official decision has been announced yet. The French Prime Minister stated that extensive security operations will be implemented for the protests planned on Saturday.

Real Madrid defeated Leipzig 4-1 in the third week of the Champions League. Goals for Real were scored by Bernardo Silva, Arda Guler, Kylian Mbappe, and Diamonde. In other matches, Bayern Munich and Arsenal drew 2-2, while Inter, Real Betis, and Aston Villa won their games.

Manshe Amir stated that Netanyahu's recent positions on overthrowing the Islamic Republic indicate a shift in Israel's security approach. Israel does not intend to launch a ground attack on Iran and will likely focus on airstrikes. Military threats from the US and Israel may be used as leverage in negotiations but are unlikely to succeed.

Arash Aramesh stated that the presence of three American naval groups in the Middle East goes beyond a defensive posture and may indicate readiness for an attack on the Islamic Republic. He added that US-Israel military cooperation increases their operational capability, but the ultimate goal remains unclear. He also emphasized that economic pressure alone will not lead to regime change and civilians and infrastructure should not bear the cost of military confrontation.

Alireza Nourizadeh considered the claim of the disappearance of Ali Khamenei's will unbelievable. He said copies of the document are kept in the Assembly of Experts and other places. Nourizadeh suggested that the will might contradict the hereditary succession of Mojtaba Khamenei, which could be why it is not published.

The office of Prince Reza Pahlavi warned about the execution sentence for 22-year-old protester Ilya Ben-Rashid, arrested during the January 2026 protests. Ben-Rashid was sentenced to death on charges of moharebeh, and the sentence has been communicated to him. He is held in Isfahan's Dastgerd prison and has also been sentenced to prison and travel ban.

Morad Vaisi, a senior analyst at Iran International, stated that the price of one chicken has reached one million tomans. He attributed this situation to the Islamic Republic's governance. He also pointed to the sharp increase in the dollar exchange rate.

Morad Veysi, a senior analyst at Iran International, stated that the issuance of death sentences against protesters of the December uprising is increasing. He emphasized that this decision is made by the regime, not just a judge or the Revolutionary Court. He described the executions as a continuation of suppressing protesters in the streets and hospitals.

Morad Vaisi, a senior analyst at Iran International, said Netanyahu warned Mojtaba Khamenei about continuing his deceased father's path. Alongside the news of Mojtaba Khamenei's meeting with Qalibaf, the Islamic Republic appears to intentionally leak this news to convey that Mojtaba is alive and leading negotiations.

The Kurdistan Human Rights Network reported the large-scale deployment of IRGC forces and military convoys to the cities of Sanandaj, Kamyaran, Sarvabad, Marivan, and Baneh. The deployed forces are equipped with heavy and semi-heavy weapons. Additionally, hundreds of special IRGC forces have been stationed around the villages near the Shaho mountain range in Kamyaran.

Shahram Khaledi said that airstrikes alone do not necessarily lead to the collapse of governments and their success depends on other military and political factors. He suggested that Israel might use a combination of airstrikes, intelligence operations, and special forces to weaken the Islamic Republic. He also noted that Russia's changing stance and international conditions are influential factors.

Haaretz reported that the White House's stance has shifted towards supporting a preemptive military strike against Iran. This change occurred after the US Secretary of Defense reviewed intelligence assessments following his meeting with the Israeli Prime Minister. It was also reported that Israel was prepared to attack Iran, but Trump prevented the operation.
Murad Veisi reported an increase in prisoner protests in the audio version of the Politics program.

Esmaeil Baghai, spokesperson for Iran's Foreign Ministry, stated that the obstacle to rational negotiations between Tehran and Washington is the behavior of the US and its attempts to impose unilateral demands. He accused the US of repeatedly violating diplomatic commitments and relying on pressure instead of real negotiations. This response came after Marco Rubio's remarks about the difficulty of reaching an agreement with the Islamic Republic.

The Iraqi Prime Minister's advisor accused Tehran of damaging Iraq's economy, drug trafficking, and violating the country's sovereignty. The Al-Shib border crossing has been closed to prevent the entry of drugs and counterfeit money. According to him, this measure is more dangerous than missiles and was taken by the Iraqi government.

A group of Iranian republican political and civil organizations supported the invitation of Reza Pahlavi to receive the 2026 Freedom Award. They described his political role as beyond the republic or monarchy dispute. They emphasized the need to end authoritarian rule and establish secular and democratic institutions.

Dozens of Israeli Air Force jets conducted an exercise flying through Syrian and Iraqi airspace near the Iranian border. The exercise aimed to demonstrate power and deterrence against Iran. Some American sources expressed concern about a possible Iranian reaction to the operation.
The King Fahd International Airport in Dammam was attacked on Wednesday night. The attack resulted in one death and eight injuries. Material damages were also caused and their assessment is ongoing.

The New York Times reported that the US and Israeli militaries have planned short but intense attacks on Iran after the US midterm elections. The likely targets include Iran's energy infrastructure, nuclear facilities, and missile arsenal. Donald Trump's final decision is still unknown, and the likelihood of the operation starting this month is low.

Donald Trump claimed in his speech that the United States has destroyed Iran's nuclear enrichment capability and defeated Iran militarily and financially. He emphasized that Iran will never have nuclear weapons and defended his withdrawal from the JCPOA. Trump also renamed the Strait of Hormuz as the "Trump Strait."

The Wall Street Journal, citing Kepler analysts, reported that Iran's crude oil reserves in tankers stationed in Asian waters have been depleted by mid-October. Despite the US naval blockade, these reserves had allowed Iran to continue selling oil to China. The US blockade has prevented the replacement of sold shipments.

The mayor of Moscow announced that Russia shot down more than 630 drones heading towards Moscow. Two people outside Moscow were injured in the attack. No further details about the origin of the drones or damages were provided.

The Deputy Minister of Health announced a reduction in the consumption of essential items such as dairy products to half the recommended amount. Reports indicate a higher prevalence of obesity among women and a malnutrition crisis in southeastern Iran. This issue was discussed in an interview with Nezameddin Misaghi.

Mohammad Qaedi says that despite Saudi Arabia's military superiority and broader alliances, the Houthi attacks and insecurity in part of the country's airspace indicate that the deterrence balance remains fragile.

Hossein Ghazian said economic pressure in Iran has weakened trust and social cohesion. He added that the middle class has lost its position due to inability to cover living expenses and cultural consumption. This has reduced the social and political role of this class.

Benjamin Netanyahu, the Prime Minister of Israel, called the Islamic Republic an existential threat to Israel. He stated that he has given the necessary orders to the army to overthrow it. These remarks were made ahead of the Israeli elections.

The death sentence has been issued for Ilya Ben-Rashid, a protester arrested during the December protests. The death sentence for Manouchehr Fallah, a political prisoner, has also been confirmed by the Supreme Court. Human rights organizations have warned about these sentences.

Tensions between North and South Korea have risen with a warning from Kim Yo-jong about propaganda and military actions at the border. Seoul has stated it will respond firmly to any provocative actions by Pyongyang. The commander of the US Eighth Army emphasized the readiness of US forces in South Korea.

The Navy of the IRGC discovered and attacked four illegal ships transferring oil cargo in the Persian Gulf. Three other illegal ships collided with mines west of the Strait of Hormuz and were damaged. The IRGC warned that continued US provocations would escalate confrontations to the bases of the aggressors in the region.

Donald Trump said that he is not currently negotiating with Iran, but something will happen soon. He added that this will likely occur after the election and that what the US has done with Iran is amazing. Trump also said that they are performing very well militarily and financially against Iran.

Hassanali Akhlaghi Amiri stated that over 80 parliament members have requested a review and reconsideration of the country's defense doctrine in a letter to the Supreme National Security Council. This request has been submitted for expert examination to the authorities. He also commented on the developments in the Strait of Hormuz and the Persian Gulf and Iran's potential response if the US commits aggression.

Reports from various cities in Iran highlight economic conditions and people's difficulties. High medical costs, shortage of domestic medicines, rising dental service prices, and issues with bread flour supply are among the concerns. Employers are trying to retain their staff despite harsh economic conditions.

Manchester United suffered a 4-1 defeat against Como in the Champions League, entering a new crisis. Bruno Fernandes openly criticized Michael Carrick's tactical decisions. Carrick called the team's performance unacceptable and did not comment on his job future.
On the evening of Wednesday, October 21, long lines of cars formed in front of fuel stations in Bandar Abbas. People waited to receive gasoline. This was shown in a video sent to Iran International.

Los Angeles Lakers defeated Golden State Warriors 127-105 in the first game of the new NBA season. This match took place after LeBron James' departure and Lakers' ownership change. Luka Dončić and Walker Kessler were standout players in the game.

Fadahossein Maleki, a member of parliament and head of the Iran-Pakistan parliamentary friendship group, said the reopening of the land border has been one-sided and if Pakistan continues to block trucks from Iran, the Islamic Republic will also close the border. He attributed the restrictions to US pressure and asked the Pakistani ambassador to come to parliament to discuss the issue.

Hossein Alizadeh stated that despite the halt in direct negotiations between Iran and the US, message exchanges through intermediaries continue. He views Donald Trump's remarks about the "unfinished business" with the Islamic Republic as a sign of a possible swift US action.

Two recent polls show that the Yeshar party led by Gadi Eisenkot is leading with 20 to 23 seats. The Likud party led by Benjamin Netanyahu is in second place with 19 seats. This report was prepared by Reza Mohaddes for Iran International.
An abandoned newborn was found in one of the streets of Yasuj city.
A video shows a student in Mashhad scribbling on and tearing images of Ruhollah Khomeini in their textbook. This video was sent to Iran International.

The Human Rights Headquarters of the Islamic Republic expressed concern about the protests in Albania. It called on the Albanian government to allow peaceful protests and dialogue with citizens. It also demanded the publication of accurate statistics on detainees and injured protesters.

The price of the US dollar in Iran's free market surpassed 273,000 tomans on Thursday, October 30. At the same time, the prices of the euro and pound also increased, reaching approximately 307,000 tomans and 366,000 tomans respectively. Additionally, the price of each new design coin (Emami) exceeded 275 million tomans.

The German financial supervisory authority revoked Bank Saderat Iran's license due to continuous regulatory violations. The authority also ordered the bank's dissolution. The 2023 inspection revealed serious deficiencies in the bank's structure and management.

The managers of Esteghlal club signed a memorandum of understanding with the Serbian National Sports Academy. This agreement includes cooperation in sports infrastructure, stadium construction, and exchange of managers and athletes. Concerns have been raised about the feasibility and costs of this agreement given the current economic conditions.

Reza Najafi, a resident of Gorgan, was summoned and interrogated by the city's security police. After several hours of interrogation and signing a written commitment to refrain from political activities, he was released. This occurred on October 20 and 21.

Hossein Aghaei from Iran International said Israeli fighter maneuvers near Iran are part of preliminary war stages. The maneuvers aim to practice operations, assess defensive capabilities, and test refueling and ammunition delivery. He mentioned two possible attack scenarios: limited airstrikes or broader attacks targeting officials and infrastructure.

Morteza Kazemian from Iran International said Trump emphasizes a quick end to the war and long-term stability, indicating the ongoing crisis between Tehran and Washington. He referred to the IRGC's stance and military actions in the Strait of Hormuz as signs of the regime's disregard for balance of power. Kazemian believes there is no clear prospect for ending the crisis as long as the Islamic Republic remains.

Benjamin Netanyahu, the Prime Minister of Israel, denied reports that Donald Trump prevented a planned Israeli military attack on the Islamic Republic. He described the threat from the Islamic Republic as a key issue in the upcoming elections and emphasized the need to overthrow the Iranian regime. Netanyahu likened Iran's nuclear program to cancer and stated that Iran continues to rebuild its nuclear capabilities.

Bayern Munich remained unbeaten after a 2-2 draw against Arsenal in the third week of the UEFA Champions League. The team has not lost in 39 consecutive home matches in the group or league stages of the Champions League. Bayern's last home defeat in these stages was in December 2013.

Donald Trump, the President of the United States, said at a Republican gathering in South Carolina that America has destroyed the Islamic Republic's nuclear enrichment capability and has defeated this government militarily and financially.

Amir Mohammad Ostaddoost was killed by direct gunfire from Khamenei's forces during the January 8 protests in Ramsar. This incident occurred during the protests. His memory remains a guiding light for freedom seekers.
Several German visa applicants protested in front of the embassy on October 20. They objected to delays in scheduling embassy appointments. Some have lost their contracts due to the long wait.

Messages received by Iran International indicate worsening living conditions in Iran. Citizens report rising prices of food, water and electricity bills, and gasoline queues. Bakers have also announced higher bread prices and weight-based sales starting from early Aban.

Ali Shirazi stated that the higher authorities of the Islamic Republic have ordered an immediate internet shutdown if another war begins. The purpose is to cut off the connection of people inside Iran with the outside world. It is also to prevent access to free information and to counter potential cyber attacks.

Abdel Fattah el-Sisi stated that Egypt's military support for Saudi Arabia is limited to defending its land and borders and does not include attacks on Yemen. He added that Egypt will also defend the land and borders of other Arab countries if requested.

A plan to deploy 500 army forces in the streets of Italy was approved following recent unrest. Damaged shops are being repaired and luxury stores have increased their security measures. The army forces do not have independent police powers, and concerns about repeated violence have increased.

Mohsen Rezaei confirmed that the Islamic Republic forces have targeted an average of five vessels each night in the Strait of Hormuz over the past two to three months. He described these vessels as belonging to smugglers. The Islamic Republic considers the passage of vessels through the Strait of Hormuz unauthorized.

On the early morning of October 22, Russian attacks on Kyiv caused a massive explosion and several fires. At least 15 people were injured and the metro infrastructure was damaged. The attacks continue despite new US efforts for mediation.

Hadi Jalali, a political prisoner in Jiroft prison, is deprived of access to his medications and proper medical care due to neurological and psychiatric illnesses. He is held in the criminal offenses ward without basic facilities. This situation has been reported by a source close to his family.

Senior authorities have officially stated that if a new war begins, Iranian users' access to international internet must be immediately cut off. This report was published by the economic media Zoman. Mehdi Tajik, a member of the Iran International editorial team, discussed this issue.

Omid and Chamran Ahmadi Nejad, residents of Ahvaz, were arrested by the Intelligence Force of the IRGC. Their residences were searched and personal belongings were confiscated. The arrests took place early on Wednesday, October 21.

Donald Trump stated that the US is not currently negotiating with Iran and that something will happen soon. Mohsen Rezaei said negotiations have stopped and Iran has the capability to continue missile and drone operations. Rezaei also warned that in case of a new war, US casualties would be ten times higher.

The IRGC Navy claimed to have targeted four ships transporting oil cargo in the Persian Gulf. Additionally, three other ships in the western Strait of Hormuz hit mines and caught fire. The IRGC accused the US of provoking vessels to pass through an illegal route.

Mostafa Sepahvand stated in a London court that he was forced to cooperate due to threats from the IRGC. He is one of three accused of gathering information for violent actions against Iran International journalists. The accused are charged with collecting information against Mojtaba Pourmohsen and Kambiz Hosseini.

Houshang Nasirzadeh commented on the insults directed at Karim Bagheri during the Tractor vs Malavan match, saying it is sometimes a personal score-settling and not a problem. He also questioned what issue Malavan fans had with Shoja Khalilzadeh, noting that he has not left the Tractor team.

The CEO of Tractor club announced the possibility of the team withdrawing from the match against Al Ain due to the lack of approval for their own airline's flight. The request for a direct flight permit came with a $100,000 fee that the club cannot afford. Tractor previously experienced a difficult flight route in the Elite League of Asia.

Foreign ministers of Turkey, Egypt, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, the UK, Germany, and France will meet in Istanbul on Friday to discuss key regional and international developments. Main topics include Palestine, the Strait of Hormuz, Yemen developments, and efforts to end the Russia-Ukraine war. The report is by Farzia Sabti from Iran International.

Mohammad Azizi, a resident of Alvand, has been held in Choubinder Prison in Qazvin for over 30 days without a clear judicial status. He is accused of propaganda against the regime, disturbing public order, insulting the leader, and insulting sacred matters. This information was confirmed by a source close to his family.

CENTCOM released images of an EA-18G Growler electronic warfare aircraft taking off from the USS George Washington aircraft carrier. The carrier continues to support its assigned missions. One of these missions includes enforcing the US 'Iron Wall' blockade against Iranian ports and coastal areas.

The prosecutor of Bam announced the formation of a judicial case regarding the injury of a student due to corporal punishment by a teacher. The incident occurred on October 21, and the eleventh-grade student of Alaviyeh High School was injured in the head and face. The case is under investigation to examine the incident's details and determine legal responsibility.

The Deputy of Social Health of the Welfare Organization announced the identification of over 70,000 people at high risk of post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). In this plan, 435,159 people participated, with 45% men and 55% women. More than 23,000 individuals were referred to counseling centers for specialized services.

The Labkhand Theater hall in Tehran was sealed and performances have been suspended until further notice. This hall hosted performances during the first two days of the Theater Experience Festival. After two days, the festival's performances at this venue were stopped.

Reports highlight various life difficulties in Iran, including threats of expulsion in schools, high medical costs, drug shortages in hospitals, and rising living expenses. Salaries do not cover basic costs, and people express dissatisfaction with the current situation. Criticism is also directed at Islamic Republic officials for their affluent lifestyles.

Two branches of the Lozi perfume and cologne store in Behbahan were sealed due to non-compliance with mandatory hijab. This occurred on Tuesday, October 19, 2026. Harana News Agency reported this incident.

Nazanin Sharifian, known as Dvora in Hebrew, will become the first Persian-speaking member of the Israeli parliament. She represents the Yashar party led by Gadi Eisenkot. This news was reported by Iran International.

A Tehran citizen sent a video showing the installation of images of Mohammad Reza Shah Pahlavi and Prince Reza Pahlavi in Tehran. He described this action as "Aban, the month of kings." The video was published by Iran International.

Jafar Pourkabgani, representative of Bushehr, stated that the Islamic Republic must first establish its superiority and capability on the ground before entering negotiations. He emphasized that relying on negotiations without deterrent power cannot guarantee national interests. He also referred to recent enemy threats about using powerful bombs and expressed hope for the end of US presence in the region and the elimination of Israel.

A few hours after Vladimir Putin's meeting with Steve Witkoff, Russia launched new missile and drone attacks on Kyiv and other parts of Ukraine. At least one person was killed and 22 injured in these nighttime attacks. Residential buildings and civilian infrastructure were damaged.

The human rights organization Hiwa has requested the Federal Prosecutor's Office of Germany to start investigations into possible crimes against humanity in Iran. The request includes examining the suppression of Kurds and Baluchis and the 'Women, Life, Freedom' protests. Hiwa also called for investigating the role of security forces and decision-makers in these events.

On the fourth day of the 2026 Para Asian Games, Iran won 5 gold, 11 silver, and 6 bronze medals. Iran is currently in sixth place in the medal table with a total of 22 medals. Iranian athletes won medals in para-athletics, powerlifting, and para-swimming.

Alireza Beiranvand was injured in the 6th minute of the match between Tractor and Sanat Naft and left the field. Iranian media reported this is Beiranvand's last game with Tractor before his military service.

Scott Bessent announced that no oil tankers carrying crude oil are currently seen at Khark Island. He described this as a symbol of the Iranian government's failure. He also stated that the economic expulsion operation is cutting off the Islamic Republic's financial resources.

Mark Carney, the Prime Minister of Canada, traveled to Ankara for a three-day visit. The purpose of the trip is to expand political, commercial, and security cooperation with Turkey. More details were provided in an interview with an Iran International reporter.

The European Union awarded the 2026 Sakharov human rights prize to the International Criminal Court and its judges. Taraneh and Romina Rahimi and Tundu Lissu were among the nominees. More details were provided in an interview with an Iran International reporter.
Meysam Shahin, Malavan's media manager, stated that Tractor left the field. He emphasized that the rule is clear in this matter. The match result should be declared 3-0 in favor of Malavan.

The Israeli Prime Minister visited the Leviathan gas platform with the Energy Minister. Netanyahu stated that 400 billion shekels have been extracted from the sea and added to the state treasury. The Haifa naval base commander provided a security report on the protection of the Leviathan platform.

A citizen explained in a video to Iran International that increasing the amount of ration coupons leads to higher prices and more inflation. He referred to the rising prices in Iran. These remarks relate to inflation and economic policies.

Tractor football team defeated Sanat Naft Abadan 3-0 in the tenth week of the Premier League. All three goals were scored in the last half hour of the match. With this win, Tractor reached 20 points and ranked second in the standings.

Donald Trump stated that the Islamic Republic is trying to raise oil prices before the US midterm elections. He claimed Iran spreads fake news about attacks and mines and kills protesters. Trump also emphasized that Iran will never have nuclear weapons.
Videos received by Iran International show a large oil leak on the coast of Qeshm. The leak is caused by targeted ships in the Persian Gulf. These videos are from Thursday, October 22.

The head of the Behzisti office in Gerash announced the identification of 35 child laborers in the city. These children were identified about a year and a half ago with the cooperation of the Red Crescent Society. This action was taken to support child laborers.

The Victoria and Albert Museum in London is holding an exhibition of Freddie Mercury's personal items to mark his 80th birthday. Eight iconic outfits of the British singer will be displayed. This news was mentioned in an interview with Ali Rashid from Iran International.

Donald Trump wrote on Truth Social that the Islamic Republic of Iran continues to kill protesters and anyone who stands in its way. He claimed that 75,000 protesters have been killed in less than seven months. Trump called the Iranian government evil and criticized the lack of attention to this issue in the world and the US.

The mother of Maedeh Moradi Kian announced that the photo and inscription on her daughter's grave have been removed. Maedeh, 22 years old, was killed on January 9, 2026, in Qaemshahr. Her mother reported this in a video and expressed pride in her daughter.

In Iran, women face legal and social restrictions due to the lack of a clear procedure for issuing motorcycle licenses. This ban has become a social and political issue limiting women's independence. The report examines the roots of this ban and women's resistance.

Mohammad Saleh Jokar stated that countries allowing the US to use their airspace for attacks on Iran will face a harsh response from the Islamic Republic. He also called for permission to use deterrent weapons, including nuclear ones, if the US attacks. Jokar said the US failed to achieve its goals in the 40-day war.

The head of the Fourth Criminal Court of Syria announced that the verdicts issued in absentia for Bashar Assad and Maher Assad have been officially sent to Interpol. These verdicts were sent to pursue the legal process of arrest and extradition to Syria. In this case, eight people were tried in absentia, and Atef Najib was sentenced to death.

The mother of Farzin Poostashkan visited his grave and expressed happiness that he went for the homeland. Farzin Poostashkan, 26 years old, was killed on January 8, 2026, in Isfahan. A video of this moment has been released.

The Jerusalem Post reported that the Israeli military intelligence, through US mediation, provides special information to Saudi Arabia to assist in operations against the Houthis. This cooperation aligns with Israel's national interests and political directives. Saudi Arabia is conducting extensive attacks on Houthi targets to weaken their military capabilities.

In work-related incidents in Hamedan, Boukan, and Arak, one worker died and three others were injured. An official reported the death of 21 workers and injury of 349 others in the first six months of this year in Hamedan. These statistics relate to work-related accidents.

170 workers of the Alloy Steel project in Bafq have been unemployed and uncertain since August 3. They demand the continuation of their work and employment. Additionally, some social security retirees reported delays in receiving their October pensions.

Hamed Momeni reported discussions with the UAE Football Federation Secretary General regarding Tractor Club's travel to the UAE. The UAE Football Federation Secretary General promised to follow up on the charter flight permit for the club. The Tractor CEO announced the possibility of withdrawing from the match against Al Ain if the permit is not granted.
Shirvan Soleimannejad, a citizen of Urmia, was arrested by intelligence forces on Monday, October 19. He was transferred to an unknown location. There has been no news about his condition so far.

Saeed Fattahi, head of the football organization of Esteghlal club, stated that after Tractor club's criticism, more restrictions have been imposed on Iranian airplanes. These restrictions have forced clubs to use larger and more expensive planes. Tractor club also criticized the high costs of government flights and mentioned the possibility of canceling the match with Al Ain.
